name: COVID-19 Global Market Crash & Liquidity Freeze
description: Global pandemic outbreak triggering unprecedented worldwide quarantine lockdowns, commercial aviation shutdowns, corporate credit market freezes, and a 34% drop in the S&P 500.

headlines.text: Global equity markets suffer worst single-day drop since 2008 as novel coronavirus cases surge across northern Italy, South Korea, and Iran.
S&P 500 hits 7% circuit breaker at market open as Saudi Arabia and Russia launch crude oil price war amidst collapsing global travel demand.
World Health Organization officially declares COVID-19 a global pandemic as nationwide curfews and transatlantic flight restrictions are enacted.
Federal Reserve cuts interest rates to zero in emergency Sunday move and announces $700 billion quantitative easing to unfreeze Treasury liquidity.
Commercial paper and prime money market funds experience severe liquidity strains, prompting emergency secondary credit facility backstops.
Federal Reserve pledges open-ended unlimited asset purchases and establishes Primary & Secondary Corporate Credit Facilities to support commercial debt.
